title: R&SVP – Hio Ridge | Barn wedding venue, Bridgton, Maine
description: A barn wedding venue in Bridgton, Maine, with a ceremony field facing Pleasant Mountain. Sunday and weekday weddings for up to 135 guests.

hero.alt: Inside the barn at Hio Ridge in the evening: the timber frame, chandeliers, and the loft rail
hero.headline: Vows facing Pleasant Mountain. *Dinner under the beams.*
hero.line: A barn wedding venue on our family farm in Bridgton, Maine

statement.quote: There's something about these 1820 beams you have to see in person.

intro.heading: Your table, *right by the French doors.*
body: Picture your head table by the open French doors, with the field beyond. The original barn boards line the room, and the old house windows let in the light.
We include tables and chairs with rental. Your caterer has a prep kitchen for finishing the meal. Our total event capacity is 135; Susan can walk through a seating plan for your guest count.
intro.alt: The head table set at the open French doors, the field beyond

paths.title: Before the walk down the aisle
paths.body: Your wedding party can get ready with you in the bridal room. The groom's party has a separate room in the ell beside the barn.
paths.alt: A wedding dress on the hook in the bridal room

paths.title: Your vows, with the mountain in view
paths.body: Pleasant Mountain lies beyond the ceremony field. Your guests sit on benches we made from the barn's old floorboards.
paths.alt: Benches in the field and the farmhouse in evening light

paths.title: Around the table together
paths.body: Explore the main floor and loft as you think about where everyone will sit. We have long tables and rounds for your reception.
paths.alt: Inside the barn in the evening, chandeliers and the loft rail

setting.heading: An October wedding, *with color on the mountain.*
setting.body: The trees beyond the ceremony field turn in autumn. If you're drawn to an October wedding, come see the view of Pleasant Mountain. We host events from May through October.
setting.alt: The barn across the lawn in early October, trees turning along the tree line

evening.heading: A few more minutes *on the patio.*
evening.body: Some conversations carry on after dinner. Our patio gives guests a place to sit outside, with string lights beside the barn. The stone seating circle is nearby in the field.
evening.alt: The barn at night, windows lit, French doors open onto the patio

proof.title: See the spaces in person
proof.body: A tour gives you a feel for the barn and the ceremony field. Susan can walk through the layout with your guest list in mind.

proof.title: Get the rental details
proof.body: Our pricing brochure is the place to start comparing costs. Tables and chairs are included. You can request the brochure before arranging a tour.

proof.title: Meet Susan and Richard
proof.body: We restored the barn on Susan's family farm. We host the events here, and we're on site when you celebrate.

story_teaser.heading: The house windows *found a home in the barn.*
story_teaser.body: When Richard wanted new windows for the house, Susan wanted the old ones in the barn. We kept its original boards, too. Susan's family has owned the farm since 1941.
story_teaser.alt: Susan and Richard Voth at the barn door

closing.heading: Come see where *you’d say your vows.*
closing.body: Walk through the barn and out to the field with Susan. No date yet? A season and an approximate guest count are enough to start. You can request our pricing brochure before visiting.
